messages:
Maria: FYI - CI microbench failed on PR-21005, kv-prefetch benchmark exceeded threshold for P99 on short sequences (~+11%).
PerfBot: [alert] benchmark/kv-prefetch microbench: P99 +11.3% over baseline. CI link: https://ci.redwood/6001920011
Aj: Any flamegraphs or quick repros attached?
Maria: Uploaded flamegraph and perf map to the job artifacts. Key snippet shows contention in slab_alloc_mutex around prefetch_submit().
Maria: Log excerpt:
```
prefetch_chunks=4 -> 8
batcher_impl=continuous_v3
hotpath: prefetch_submit() -> slab_alloc_mutex.lock() -> stall_wait()
```
Tom: I reproduced with the local harness. Bisect lands on commit def4567 from PR-21005 (tuning prefetch_chunks and a minor batcher tweak).
Tom: Local microbench numbers: baseline P99=7.6ms, post-change P99=8.45ms, tailgrowth ~11%.
Aj: Can you share your bisect steps so infra can repeat?
Tom: Sure:
``
git bisect start origin/main origin/main~40
git bisect run tools/microbench/run_kv_prefetch.sh --seq=16 --iters=20000
# result: def4567
```
Sara: This is blocking the canary rollout - perf gate tripped. PMs need an ETA for a fix or revert.
Kevin: Confirmed - rollout blocked until the perf regression is resolved or reverted.
Maria: Repro script used by CI: `./ci/microbench/kv_prefetch.sh --seq-len=16 --iters=20000` attached to job artifacts.
PerfBot: Historical baseline variance: +/-1.8% over 30d. Current delta is outside noise band.
Aj: Is this due to kernel autoselect logic in the same PR or purely allocator tuning?
Tom: The PR touched allocator prefetch chunk count and a batching timeout in batcher.cc. Instrumentation points to higher lock hold time after chunk count increase. Not kernel selector.
Tom: Quick patch I tested locally (adaptive chunk count):
```
- prefetch_chunks = 8;
+ prefetch_chunks = clamp(4, seq_len / 2, 8);
```
Tom: With the adaptive change P99 returns to ~7.7ms locally.
Maria: Can we do a minimal emergency revert of the chunk bump while keeping the batching timeout tweak? That should reduce risk.
Tom: Opening revert PR now: https://github.com/redwood/pr/21500 (revert def4567 chunk bump).
InfraBot: CI triggered for pr/21500, job id 6001920055.
PerfBot: pr/21500 preliminary microbench: P99 back to 7.65ms, within baseline.
Kevin: If CI stays green we'll unblock the canary. Sara will draft rollback advisory and notify stakeholders.
Sara: Drafting advisory, will include perf regression details and root cause notes. @Maria please attach the failing artifacts to ENGR-5301.
Maria: Done - artifacts and flamegraphs linked in ENGR-5301: https://jira.redwood/browse/ENGR-5301
Aj: Follow-ups: add a microbench regression test asserting <5% P99 change for seq-len <= 24 when touching prefetch/allocator tuning. Creating ticket ENGR-5302.
Tom: Also adding unit tests to simulate lock hold under increased prefetch_chunks.
Maria: Thanks all. Monitoring canary once revert merges. :thumbsup:
Kevin: Keep updates here, and ping if the canary shows any odd signals.
